patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — BookYourData and Outreach share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

BookYourData and Outreach share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose BookYourData only if your buying job matches “Real-time B2B contact database for building verified prospect lists with pay-as-you-go cre” rather than Outreach's shape. Choose Outreach only if your buying job matches “Enterprise sales engagement / AI revenue platform — Amplify Essentials/Core/Plus/Pro packa” rather than BookYourData's shape. Workflow advantage: BookYourData leans email-outreach; Outreach leans sales-engagement. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — BookYourData and Outreach share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: BookYourData is Real-time B2B contact database for building verified prospect lists with pay-as-you-go credits and a 97% deliverability guarantee.; Outreach is Enterprise sales engagement / AI revenue platform — Amplify Essentials/Core/Plus/Pro packages; request pricing (seat + AI credits)..
- Workflow coverage skew: BookYourData-leaning email-outreach vs Outreach-leaning sales-engagement.
- Researched limits: BookYourData — none listed; Outreach — Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core.
